decisions.statement: A `bun test` made inside the checkout is refused whatever paths that call names.
A `bun test` this reads as a command word is refused whatever paths it names.
The refusal names the apply rather than the draft as where the tests run.
A prefix that only runs the call behind that prefix does not hide a `bun test` from this hook.
No word after the act is read.
`bun run test` is not read here.
`bun test` runs a filter over every test file rather than a path `bun test` is handed.
The repository root is the akasha folder.
Every test file the akasha folder has is an akasha test.

definition: a refusal of every bun test call made inside the akasha checkout
